name: Ferreira (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of white, green and red, the green of double width, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ferreira (a bend, a tree and a castle).
history: Ferreira adopted its arms officially on 15 October 2004 and its flag on 14 March 2008; the flag is a cloth of 2:3 divided vertically into three stripes, the middle green and double the outer ones, white at the hoist and red at the fly, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Ferreira arms — bend, tree and castle
